description: Since 2026-10-28, 55 of 267 develop pushes have no dist because trunk.yml's workflow-level concurrency group `trunk-develop` replaced their run before it finished. Admission (release-artifacts.md:41-45; scripts/release_admitted_dist.py:130; scripts/release_artifact_consumer.py:191-218) accepts only a dist from a successful trunk.yml push run on the exact tagged commit, so those commits can never be released, and releases needed a develop freeze. Owner decision 2026-11-06: fix this at the source. Change trunk.yml concurrency so a newer push never cancels or replaces an older push's run (per-SHA group or no cancel-in-progress; queueing is acceptable), so every develop push commit gets a completed run with its tests and dist. The admission contract is unchanged: a release still needs a successful trunk run on the exact tagged commit. Also make release-check and trunk-uat (rv2r-02) name the newest releasable commit when the chosen commit's run failed. Rollback: revert this member's commits.
